text.p: Campbell Soup Co said on Monday that it realigned its business structure, forming a division that combines international and specialty foods.

Campbell International and Specialty Foods will bring together bakery & confectionery, international grocery, global food service and frozen & specialty foods, the company said. The new division's 1996 sales were in excess of $4 billion.
Campbell's other operating division is U.S. Grocery, which had 1996 sales of more than $3 billion from soups, salsa, spaghetti sauce, vegetable juice and pasta, the company said.
Dale Morrison was promoted president of Campbell International and Specialty Foods from president of the Pepperidge Farm business.
Robert Bernstock continues as president -- U.S. Grocery and a corporate senior vice president, the company said.
The realignment and appointments are effective December 2, the company said.
